biggest_catch: Requires parking $5,000 of new money (not held at Liberty in the last 90 days) and the offer is limited-time with no fixed expiration — it can be cancelled without notice. $250 for a single deposit, paid within 30 days after verification.
catches: Offer valid for a limited time only and subject to change or cancellation without notice — no fixed expiration date is published.
Opening deposit of $5,000 or more must be 'new money' (funds not held on deposit in any Liberty Savings Bank or affiliated account within the last 90 days).
CD and IRA accounts are strictly excluded; offer is for new checking or savings relationships only — not for opening additional accounts when both account types are already maintained.
The $250 bonus is deposited within 30 days following verification of the initial qualifying $5,000 deposit, provided the account remains open and in good standing.
Limit one gift and one cash bonus per customer/household.
Liberty Savings Bank is Florida-focused; eligibility is for customers establishing a new checking or savings relationship with Liberty (FL).
The Tervis America250 bottle is awarded in-branch at account opening or shipped 'within a reasonable timeframe,' while supplies last; Liberty may substitute a gift of equal value.
